2609.17346.title: Where Should a Document Live: Context, Representations, or Parameters?
2609.17346.paper_summary: To answer questions outside of their pre-training data, large language models (LLMs) need access to new information, which can be presented in the context window as documents, encoded into the model's parameters, or injected as latent representations. However, each of these methods comes with different efficiency, cost, and performance trade-offs, with no single winner. We present a controlled comparison of representation-based (KV-cache based) and parametric (fine-tuning-based) adaptation methods on five knowledge-intensive benchmarks. We show that in the oracle setting, Cartridges (KV) are the most accurate injection method at nearly every storage budget, outperforming parametric methods by 10 points. Compaction (KV) matches Cartridges only at low compression rates, lagging behind the parametric methods by 10 points at rates higher than $50\times$. In the more realistic multi-document retrieval scenario, Cartridges are the only method that matches in-context learning (ICL), leading the parametric methods by 29 points and Compaction by 15 points. Nonetheless, Cartridges are also the only method, besides full fine-tuning and large MLP adapters, that suffers from catastrophic forgetting, i.e., a 6% performance degradation on control benchmarks, with 13% in coding.
2609.17346.paper_summary_zh: 為了回答超出其預訓練數據的問題，大型語言模型（LLMs）需要訪問新信息，這可以以文檔的形式呈現在上下文窗口中，編碼到模型的參數中，或作為潛在表示注入。然而，這些方法各有不同的效率、成本和性能權衡，沒有單一的勝者。我們對基於表示（基於KV快取）和參數（基於微調）適應方法在五個知識密集型基準上的控制比較進行了介紹。我們顯示，在預言者設置中，Cartridges（KV）幾乎在每個存儲預算下都是最準確的注入方法，超過參數方法10分。壓縮（KV）僅在低壓縮率下與Cartridges相匹配，在高於$50\times$的壓縮率下落後於參數方法10分。在更現實的多文檔檢索場景中，Cartridges是唯一能與上下文學習（ICL）相匹配的方法，領先參數方法29分，領先壓縮15分。然而，Cartridges也是唯一一種除了完全微調和大型MLP適配器外，會遭受災難性遺忘的方法，即在控制基準上性能下降6%，在編碼上下降13%。
